title_options: Claude Just Found New Biology in Viruses #shorts
1,000 AI Agents Discover Novel Enzyme System #shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
Anthropic deployed ~1,000 Claude agents to scan nearly 2 billion protein clusters. In about 21 hours, it discovered ART—a novel enzyme system hidden inside viruses with CRISPR-like repeating arrays. Wet-lab validated in San Francisco. Not a human gene therapy, but a brand new biological architecture.
